categoryNotes.Jobs: Remote roles first, then Greater Philadelphia. None lean heavily on Power BI.

items.author: Eric Summers, 2x Tableau Ambassador, rebuilds Tableau dashboards as data apps, Nov 23
items.summary: "Studio or Data Apps? Part 2": same Superstore prompt, one shot. Tableau Studio finished in 5:10 with no help; Data Apps took 13:55 and two nudges but returned a custom app Tableau hosts and governs. Studio is the fast path to a dashboard; Data Apps take know-how. 5 reactions, 4 comments.

items.author: Steve Adams, Tableau & AI trainer, The Insights Collective, 4x Tableau Ambassador, Nov 23
items.summary: An AI-built chart said $45K when the real figure was $44,998; the bigger issue is that uploading copies to AI tools loses governance, audit trail and token efficiency. Connect AI to the trusted published source instead. Just posted, no counts yet.

items.author: Zakaria Labidi, Fractional Power BI Lead, semantic modeling, DAX & Fabric, Nov 23
items.summary: Once Claude and ChatGPT can query Fabric/Power BI semantic models, every modeling shortcut becomes visible; fix it with one definition per KPI, AI instructions and verified answers. 21 reactions, 15 comments, 1 repost.

items.author: Akash Agarwal, VP, Solutions & Customer Success, AI and data practices on Microsoft & Anthropic, Nov 22
items.summary: Microsoft's main Copilot can now answer straight from Power BI semantic models while the separate Power BI Copilot retires; if reports conflict, Copilot will pick one number for you. 6 reactions, 4 comments.
